_doc: Authored intent phrasings, merged into aiconnect-capabilities.json by scripts/gen_capabilities.py.
_rule: Name the OPERATION - not a material, a trade, or any everyday noun.

define_material: define structural steel concrete or rebar material
define_frame_section: create wide flange beam or column section
assign_supports: assign fixed pinned or roller supports
fix base joint degrees of freedom
apply_distributed_load: apply uniform distributed line load to beams
assign gravity floor load to frames
define_load_combination: define ultimate or serviceability limit state combo
combine dead live wind and seismic load cases
save_model: save the structural model to disk
set_model_lock: lock or unlock the structural model
get_analysis_results: extract base reactions and base shear
query joint displacements and story drift
extract member forces and bending moments
run_code_design: verify demand to capacity stress ratios
check building code compliance and safety
apply_wind_load: apply lateral wind line load to frames
run_pushover_analysis: extract capacity curve and base shear
displacement controlled lateral push and ductility
execute_sap_function: call an oapi function by dot path
invoke a sap2000 api method directly
run_sap_script: sandboxed script against the structural model
batch of api calls in one run
load_script: retrieve script code from the library
search_api_docs: find the oapi function for an operation
signature and parameters of an api function
query_function_registry: verified call patterns for an api function
known pitfalls of a sap2000 function
register_verified_function: record a working api call pattern
add a proven function to the registry
get_error_hints: recovery steps for an api return code
